step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an IoT data ingestion and processing pipeline for train condition monitoring. Sensor data from a train producer is ingested via AWS Lambda, streamed into Kinesis Data Streams, and filtered using Kinesis Data Analytics. The processed stream feeds a central Kinesis Data Stream. From there, another Lambda function writes the formatted data into DynamoDB and serves it via Amazon API Gateway to end consumers/algorithms.
